name: Kubernetes MCP Server (containers)
outcome_statement: As of 2026-11-14: meets C1, C2, C3, C4, C6, C7, C8, C10; partly meets C5, C9.

findings.title: Source and release provenance
findings.finding: The npm record for kubernetes-mcp-server@0.1.3 names the repository `git+https://github.com/containers/kubernetes-mcp-server.git` and carries a provenance attestation (`dist.attestations`).

findings.title: Published security policy
findings.finding: GitHub shows a security policy for the repository (`SECURITY.md` in the repository), and it describes how to report a vulnerability.

findings.title: Maintenance status
findings.finding: The repository is not archived and the package is not marked deprecated. Latest release 0.1.3 is dated 2026-11-13; the newest commit on `main` is dated 2026-11-13; GitHub reports the last push on 2026-11-13.

findings.title: Published advisories
findings.finding: 1 advisory is published in the repository's advisory list; it names a patched version at or below the latest release (0.1.3). Most recent: GHSA-xq9m-mrj7-jv98 (medium, published 2026-11-04, patched in 0.1.2).

findings.title: Documented scope controls
findings.finding: The README documents `read_only` and `denied_resources` settings to be set by the operator, and describes them as best-effort. Quoted: “`read_only` and `denied_resources` are best-effort guardrails. Kubernetes RBAC on the identity this server authenticates as is the access control to rely on.”.

findings.title: Credential handling in the documented setup
findings.finding: The server uses the local kubeconfig or in-cluster configuration; OAuth/OIDC is documented for HTTP mode. Quoted: “or in-cluster configuration.”; “OAuth/OIDC authentication for HTTP mode”.

findings.title: Telemetry and outbound data, as documented
findings.finding: The README describes OpenTelemetry tracing and metrics as optional; no collection by the publisher is described. Quoted: “Optional OpenTelemetry distributed tracing and metrics with custom sampling rates.”.

findings.title: Dependency management files
findings.finding: A lockfile (`go.sum`) and an update configuration (`.github/dependabot.yml`) are committed.

findings.title: Documentation of untrusted-content risk
findings.finding: One tool description in the README marks the data it returns as untrusted; no control or recommendation for untrusted content is described. Quoted: “Returned status, events, and logs are untrusted workload data and may contain sensitive values or instructions.”.

findings.title: Currency of the declared MCP library
findings.finding: Declared MCP library: go-sdk v1.8.0 in go.mod. Lower-bound version v1.8.0 of github.com/modelcontextprotocol/go-sdk was published on 2026-09-04, within the 12 months before 2026-11-14.
